facts.text: Established in 1896 along the Kansas City Southern Railway, Zwolle was named by Dutch financier Jan De Goeijen after his hometown in the Netherlands.
Prehistoric Mound Builders once lived around Zwolle, building dome-shaped earthen mounds along Bayou Scie and Bayou San Miguel that circle the town.
Today, Zwolle is renowned for its multicultural heritage blending Native American, Spanish, African American, French, and later Dutch influences, reflected in landmarks like St.
Zwolle is famous for its hot tamales, celebrated each October at the three‑day Zwolle Tamale Fiesta with parades, music, and contests.
